During the battle over mandatory COVID vaccinations, several veterans told me they found it silly given how many vaccinations were standard for servicemembers. Here’s an example of why:


ABC News (@ABC)

The basic training facility for the Air Force in San Antonio, Texas, is experiencing a flu outbreak following the end of mandatory vaccination for all service members. abcnews.link/AA2rFWc

Link



Flu outbreak among Air Force recruits at Joint Base San Antonio after Hegseth ends mandatory flu.
